assets.label: Toronto City Scape
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Standalone transparent hero foreground asset containing the Toronto skyline, CN Tower, city blocks, and waterfront edge.
Primary request: Create a standalone transparent-background cutout of the Toronto cityscape from the reference: the CN Tower, downtown buildings, Rogers Centre dome, city blocks, trees, and waterfront edge. Preserve the isometric miniature architectural render style, warm lighting, beige and grey building materials, and original perspective. Remove map background, water background, neighboring house, and full-page layout.
Input images: the crop is a reference image only. Generate a brand-new standalone asset; do not copy crop pixels.
Composition/framing: match the reference crop's subject, angle, aspect ratio, and visual weight.
Constraints: remove neighboring-page contamination, occluding unrelated assets, webpage framing, and collage leftovers.
Transparency/background: Generate on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for later alpha removal; do not use #00ff00 in the subject.
Avoid: crop output, screenshot, full page mockup, browser frame, watermark, placeholder, unrelated typography.
assets.negative_prompt: No rectangular crop background, no blue water plane, no map board, no house, no browser frame, no text, no watermark.
